official_rule.source_of_truth: The complete conversation histories are authoritative. Expected behavior and evaluation criteria express benchmark intent but are not an independent source of facts.

score_scale.4: Fully meets the criterion with no material defect.
score_scale.3: Meets the core criterion; only minor non-critical defects.
score_scale.2: Partially meets the criterion, with a material omission, error, or weak linkage.
score_scale.1: Misses or contradicts the core criterion.

official_rule.hallucination_veto: A material unsupported or source-contradicted factual claim sets hallucination=true and forces pass=false.
official_rule.pass_rule: pass = !hallucination && precision >= 3 && recall >= 3 && reasoning >= 3; proactivity is diagnostic only.

scope.sampling: Purposive sample of 10 official cases, not the complete 60-case suite.
